About Us

From an idea to a useful eco-friendly product.

Company Description

EcoInnovate Solution is a student-led business created by seven students from Tanauan City College. We developed the Bamboo and Coconut Lampshade with Charging Port to create a product that is simple, useful, and eco-friendly.

Our product uses bamboo and coconut to create a natural and unique lampshade. It provides warm lighting while also having a charging port that adds convenience for everyday use. Through teamwork, creativity, and dedication, we aim to offer a product that is both beautiful and functional.

🌱

Our Mission

Our mission is to create functional, affordable, and eco-friendly products that are useful in everyday life while encouraging creativity and responsible use of natural materials.

💚

Our Vision

Our vision is to become a creative and responsible student-led business that inspires people to choose useful, innovative, and environmentally friendly products.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is EcoInnovate Solution? +

EcoInnovate Solution is a student-led business that creates practical, functional, and eco-friendly products using natural materials.

What is the Bamboo and Coconut Lampshade with Charging Port? +

It is a handmade lampshade made from bamboo and coconut. It provides warm lighting and has a charging port for added convenience.

How much does the product cost? +

The Bamboo and Coconut Lampshade with Charging Port costs ₱615.00 per piece.

What materials are used to make the lampshade? +

The main materials are bamboo and coconut, along with electrical components, wiring, a bulb, charging port, and other supporting materials.

Where can I use the lampshade? +

It can be used in bedrooms, study areas, workspaces, living areas, and other parts of the home.

Is the product handmade? +

Yes. Each lampshade is handmade and carefully checked for its design, durability, wiring, and overall quality.

What makes the product eco-friendly? +

The product uses natural materials such as bamboo and coconut, making it a more nature-friendly choice for home decoration and lighting.

Can I order the product? +

Yes. Customers can contact EcoInnovate Solution through our contact information or social media pages to place an order.
